name: Visa exemptions

activity.text_en: What is the main purpose of your visit?

labels_en.holiday_family_meetings_transit: Tourism, family visits, meetings, incentives, conventions, exhibitions or transit.
labels_en.active_transport_crew: Serve as an active captain, pilot or transport crew member.
labels_en.crew_arriving_on_operating_vessel: Arrive directly aboard the vessel or floating equipment as its captain, crew member or foreign expert to operate in Indonesian waters, territorial sea, continental shelf or exclusive economic zone.

nationality.text_en: What is the nationality of your passport? Answer with its ISO 3166-1 two-letter country code (for example AU).

singapore_permit_holder.text_en: Do you hold a certain Singapore stay permit (for example Singapore permanent residence) that qualifies for this visa exemption?

eligible_nationality.text_en: Has your nationality been confirmed as eligible for this visa exemption?

travel_status.text_en: Which travel status applies to you?

stay_days.text_en: How many days do you need to stay?

notes: All four cards state a single entry, 30 DAY initial stay, no extension and no conversion. No sponsor is required.

A4 says certain nationalities without supplying the country list in its card. Eligibility must be confirmed against the official list; no nationality list is inferred. A36/A37 do not inherit that unstated restriction.

OWNER RULING 2026-10-19: A1 decides from the regulation-sourced list in its card (eligible_nationalities, separate from the page verbatim): 19 states/SARs per Perpres 95/2024 Lampiran A (13) and Permenimipas 10/2026 Lampiran (6), with sources and retrieval date 2026-10-19. The nationality answer is an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code; an unknown code is asked again; a known unlisted code is offered the Singapore permit-holder route (Perpres 95/2024 Lampiran B): yes gives TO_VERIFY (the 10/2026 title drops that wording; NB-2 reads the route as limited to certain Kepri entry points), no gives NOT_COVERED. 18 of the 19 (all but MO) are also B1-eligible and family B never excludes them.

The travel-status question enforces the explicit stateless/non-national-document exclusion, not document possession. Passport validity, tickets, crew registration and application steps remain checklists.
A36 and A37 overlap for some crew; the operating-vessel option states the more specific A37 activity. Their different definitions are preserved, including A37's narrower generic visa-type wording.
Only A1 has an exact commercial key. A4/A36/A37 is_sold stays null. Official zero PNBP is not a commercial price. DB itap and apply_channel stay null.
